text:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch backlog surge. We need to prioritize 9 customer-facing bugs vs 6 polish/enhancements for the next 2-week micro-iteration. Proposal: ship 3 hotfixes (P0/P1), 2 quick UX polishes, push rest to next wave. Thoughts?

Akshay: Agree on hotfix focus. Suggest triage rubric: customer impact (MAU), rollback risk, and number of customers affected. Rule of thumb: >500 MAU or 3+ complaining customers => P0.

Liz: Telemetry note: streaming-api error spike started 3/16 — 2xx->5xx regression ~4%. Affects long-poll & streaming clients. I can scope a fix; preliminary looks like a race in KV cache eviction. Recommend hotfix + canary deploy.

Ben: Also seeing onboarding completion drop ~8% post-launch for the new flow. A small polish + wording tweak could recover most of that. Can we prioritize one A/B test instead of a full redesign?

Jordan: Ops: we have capacity for a canary on dedicated infra (2 nodes) this week. I can spin it up and handle monitoring. Deploy-bot: please prep canary URL and health checks.

deploy-bot: Canary env ready at https://canary.redwood.ai (ephemeral). Last infra sync: 2026-03-20 22:04 UTC. Health checks: /health, /metrics.

Maya: Plan from here:
1) Hotfix: streaming-api (owner: Liz) — canary + rollback plan.
2) Auth/session regression (owner: Akshay) — P1/P0 triage with sessions team.
3) Onboarding A/B (owner: Ben) — quick polish experiment with acceptance metric.
Rest of bugs -> Friday grooming backlog for wave-2. @Jordan can you confirm canary schedule?

Jordan: Confirmed. Canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll attach monitors and a playbook for rollback.

Ben: I'll add the A/B hypothesis & acceptance criteria to a ticket: increase onboarding completion by +5 percentage points. PRD link in ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-1245

Maya: Also need owner for logging/telemetry alert route — Akshay? We want a page if 5xx >3% for 10m.

Akshay: I'll own alerting. I'll tune threshold, create runbook "alert -> oncall -> triage" and add a short doc in #eng-sre.

Liz: ETA for hotfix PR: EOD today. Will tag infra and Akshay for review.

Maya: Sounds good. Decision: prioritize bugs over enhancements for this micro-iteration. We'll reconvene Fri 16:00 PT for grooming and to move remaining items. :thumbsup:

Ben: +1

Akshay: +1

Liz: +1

Jordan: +1

Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll move tickets into sprint and flag blockers. If anything changes ping here.
